name: Jellyfin Edge
description: Registered proxy nodes, media caches and scoped share/download/stream links.

versions.changelog: Resolve symbolic-link media targets for file size, modification time and cache identity; preserve library filenames and media types for playback, downloads and shared streams.
Keep native downloads and stream URLs on direct host access; proxy access and shared links use Edge.
Plugin-managed HTTP block cache and scoped original/HLS exports for Jellyfin 12.2.
